module: Flowgraph node 'Record Replay' (repeat_f_duration category). Meant to record a replay of the current vehicle: the impulse 'start' then 'stop' call core_replay.toggleRecording(false). Output 'filename' updated by onReplayStateChanged when the state becomes 'recording'.
notes: The C.todo field in the code notes that the replay system does not allow choosing other vehicles.
start and stop both call toggleRecording(false) (toggle); the 'prefix' pin is only used in saveFile, which is never called.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

onReplayStateChanged.desc: Hook called by the replay system when its state changes; while recording, stores the loaded file in 'filename'.

saveFile.desc: Builds a file name (prefix or 'Recording_<id>' followed by a number) but does not use it: the function does nothing useful.

work.desc: State inactive: 'start' launches toggleRecording and goes to 'started'. State started: 'stop' launches toggleRecording again and goes to 'finished'.
